[[File:Great_glyph_of_power.png|thumb|The glyph.]]
The '''Great Glyph of Power''' was an ancient [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] symbol. According to legend, it had [[Magic/Legends|magical]] properties to it, making nearby Ewoks recover faster from tiredness. It was thought to be a more powerful version of the [[Glyph of Power]].

The glyph depicted a torch. [[Ewok glyphs]] would often be carved on trees where Ewoks lived.
